name: UK Government GHG Conversion Factors 2024 (DESNZ / Defra)
description: Official UK Government greenhouse gas conversion factors for corporate carbon reporting.

factors.name: Electricity - UK Grid Average (Location-Based)
factors.description: Standard UK national grid electricity mix (kg CO2e per kWh)

factors.name: Electricity - 100% Certified Green Tariff (Market-Based)
factors.description: Zero-carbon electricity backed by Renewable Energy Guarantees of Origin (REGO)

factors.name: Natural Gas (Gross CV)
factors.description: Piped mains natural gas for building heating and industrial boilers (kg CO2e per kWh)

factors.name: Petrol / Gasoline (Average Fleet)
factors.description: Direct fuel burn in company petrol cars and vans (kg CO2e per litre)

factors.name: Diesel (Average Fleet)
factors.description: Direct fuel burn in company diesel cars, vans, and HGVs (kg CO2e per litre)

factors.name: LPG / Propane Gas
factors.description: Bottled or bulk Liquefied Petroleum Gas (kg CO2e per litre)

factors.name: Burning Oil / Kerosene
factors.description: Commercial heating oil (kg CO2e per litre)

factors.name: Refrigerant R410A Leakage
factors.description: HVAC and heat pump refrigerant top-ups / losses (kg CO2e per kg gas)

factors.name: Flight - Domestic UK (per passenger-km)
factors.description: Domestic flights with Radiative Forcing multiplier included (kg CO2e per pkm)

factors.name: Flight - Short-haul European (per passenger-km)
factors.description: Short-haul flights within Europe in Economy class (kg CO2e per pkm)

factors.name: Flight - Long-haul International (per passenger-km)
factors.description: Long-haul flights in Economy class (kg CO2e per pkm)

factors.name: National Rail Travel (per passenger-km)
factors.description: Passenger train travel across UK national rail network (kg CO2e per pkm)

factors.name: Taxi / Ride-hailing Travel (per km)
factors.description: Business trips taken via cab or rideshare services (kg CO2e per km)

factors.name: Commercial Waste to Landfill
factors.description: Mixed general municipal solid waste sent to landfill (kg CO2e per tonne)

factors.name: Paper & Cardboard Recycling
factors.description: Sorted paper/cardboard sent for recycling processing (kg CO2e per tonne)

factors.name: Mains Water Supply
factors.description: Public water utility supply treatment and pumping (kg CO2e per m3)

factors.name: Wastewater Treatment
factors.description: Sewerage collection and wastewater treatment process (kg CO2e per m3)

factors.name: IT Hardware & Electronics Procurement
factors.description: Spend-based economic factor for computers, monitors, and phones (kg CO2e per £ spend)

factors.name: Office Supplies & Stationery Procurement
factors.description: Spend-based factor for paper, furniture, and office consumables (kg CO2e per £ spend)
